faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.heading: General frequently asked questions
faq.description: Find quick answers about browsing, selling, messaging, favorites, and managing your SayaraMatch account.
faq.q1: How do I contact a seller?
faq.a1: Open a car and start a conversation. Your messages remain available from your account dashboard.
faq.q2: How can I add my own vehicle?
faq.a2: Create a seller account, choose Sell a Car, complete the vehicle details, and upload clear photos for review.
faq.q3: Can I save cars for later?
faq.a3: Yes. Select the favorite icon on a car and find it later under My Favorites in your account.
faq.a4: Sellers manage their own cars while SayaraMatch provides structured vehicle data and moderation tools.
faq.a5: Yes. Open account Settings, choose a deletion reason, confirm the action, and submit the request.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body1: We collect account details, profile information, listing content, favorites, conversations, and technical information needed to operate and protect SayaraMatch.
privacy.body2: Information is used to provide marketplace features, connect buyers and sellers, personalize results, prevent abuse, communicate service updates, and improve reliability.
privacy.body3: Listing information is public. Private account details and conversations are only shared as required to provide the service, meet legal obligations, or protect users.
privacy.body4: We apply access controls and security safeguards appropriate to the data we process. Information is retained only while needed for the service, security, and legal requirements.
privacy.body5: You can update profile and notification settings, manage listings and favorites, or request account deletion from your dashboard settings.

terms.title: Terms Of Service
terms.body1: You must provide accurate information, keep your account secure, and use the marketplace only for lawful vehicle-related activity.
terms.body2: Sellers are responsible for listing accuracy, ownership, condition, pricing, and images. SayaraMatch may review, reject, or remove misleading or unsafe content.
terms.body3: SayaraMatch helps users discover vehicles and communicate. Buyers and sellers remain responsible for inspection, payment, transfer, and completing transactions safely.
terms.body4: Fraud, harassment, impersonation, scraping, malicious uploads, unlawful goods, and attempts to interfere with the platform are prohibited.
terms.body5: Accounts may be restricted for violations or security risks. You may delete your account from Settings, subject to retention required for security and legal compliance.
terms.body6: Features may change or occasionally be unavailable. SayaraMatch is provided without guarantees that every listing or user-submitted statement is accurate.
